name: Sensei X
versions: Sensei, Sensei X, Sensei X2 (catalogue no. SRS200; brochure LT0200 Rev. B, (c) 2014) (discontinued)
devices_driven: proprietary robotically steerable sheath (Artisan / Artisan Extend control catheter, inner and outer guide) carrying a mapping catheter (Boston Scientific Polaris-Dx or St. Jude Livewire per the indications) (hansen2016_sensei-x2_BROCHURE pp. 3, 6); outer 14 F per ren2023_critical; 14/10.5 F per mandhumula2025_robotic
device_range: inner guide bends up to 275 degrees, outer guide 90 degrees articulation (brochure p. 3); auto-retract from 1 mm per half second to 10 mm/s with 1 mm precision; motion scaling 4:1, 3:1 or 2:1 (brochure p. 4)
force_sensing: IntelliSense distal contact force estimate with visual/vibration cue; 'Intellisense Fine Force Technology' shown in visual and tactile formats (brochure p. 4)
haptics_leader: remote physician workstation with monitors and a motion controller (brochure p. 2 photo); IntelliSense vibration cue only
imaging_compat: integrates 3D mapping (CARTO, EnSite Velocity), ICE, fluoroscopy and EKG recording (brochure pp. 2-3)
sterility: Sensei System Artisan Drape (8 pack, cat. no. 06196) (brochure p. 6)
validation_detail: EP clinical use: over 14,000 procedures, 26 studies, over 2,700 patients studied (brochure p. 5, company figures)
key_numbers: radiation time 17.0 -> 11.0 (35% reduction; axis unit printed 'mm') at one hospital after starting a Sensei programme (brochure p. 5, citing Kaplan 2013); 2x tip stability vs a manual catheter (company bench data, brochure p. 4)
